[EN] , we had some of our goods disappear during a routine delivery. Our agent responsible has been...disciplined, let's say, and we recovered the missing package.

That's where you come in. Deliver this to Jerelyn as soon as you can, and reassure her that the shipping problem has been "dealt with."
[ES] , parte de nuestra mercancía desapareció durante una entrega rutinaria. Nuestro agente responsable ha sido... disciplinado, digamos, y recuperamos el paquete perdido.

Ahí es donde entras tú. Entrégale esto a Jerelyn tan pronto como puedas y asegúrale que el problema de envío ya ha sido "solucionado".

[EN] How may I help you?"This is from Ebbra."
[ES] ¿Cómo puedo ayudarte?"This is from Ebbra."

[EN] I was upset when it didn't arrive, and...what's that? "Dealt with?"

Oh, I see. None of my business, really, but that's reassuring.
[ES] Me molestó cuando no llegó y... ¿qué es eso? ¿"Solucionado"?

Oh, ya veo. En realidad no es asunto mío, pero eso es tranquilizador.
